verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships an official free browser extension, the Obsidian Web Clipper, explicitly described as letting users highlight pages and save web content directly to their vault — matching the researcher's capture-from-browser story. Community evidence also references third-party clipping plugins (e.g., ReadItLater), indicating this is a known workflow niche though not sourced as independent validation of the official clipper itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on review confirming the official Web Clipper's real-world reliability, and detail on highlight-specific capture features beyond the one-line doc description.
